title: Who Evaluates the Evaluators? On Automatic Metrics for Assessing AI-based Offensive Code Generators
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It analyzes automatic metrics for assessing AI-based generators of offensive code (e.g., for ethical hacking).
findings: This paper has no findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the study. The findings are focused on the effectiveness of different automatic metrics (like ROUGE, BLEU, Exact Match, Edit Distance) in evaluating the quality of generated offensive code in Assembly and Python, comparing them to human evaluation.
